svg.title: Horizon Local Group brand identity portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional graphic design portfolio concept for Horizon Local Group, showing an abstract brand-identity moodboard with geometric marks and swatches. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
